name: hint.list
title: List hints
summary: Open hints of the workspace, filterable by kind, type, package or variant; one page of hints at a time, total and the count per kind count all.

kind.description: Only hints with one of these codes.

type.description: Only hints about elements of one of these types, or of a type that extends one of them (SR-012).

package.description: Only hints about elements whose property with the meaning packages lists this package.

variant.description: Only hints about elements in the view of this variant (SR-043); a hint about a variant element only for that variant.

ref.description: Only the hints about this element.

limit.description: Hints of the page; total and kinds count all. Every page finds every hint again; only the dates of outdated relations (D-013) are asked for the hints of the page alone.

offset.description: Hints skipped before the page, in the order of `hints`.

kinds.description: The number of hints that pass the filters per kind (SR-026 AK6), counted over every such hint, not only the page of `limit` from `offset`. Without `kind`: each kind that has a hint, in the order its first hint has in `hints` over all pages. With `kind`: also each kind it names that has none, with count 0, after the others in the order `kind` names them. The counts add up to `total`.

count.description: Hints of this kind that pass the filters.

hints.description: The open hints: problems of severity warning about one element (the element should be checked; a hint blocks nothing and changes no status), from the same whole-workspace problems as workspace.check; errors, info and warnings about no element are not hints. Filters combine with AND. Each hint with its kind (code), the element it is about (elementId, repository, file, line, and its title elementTitle), its target where it has one (targetId; with targetRepository, targetShortId, targetIdentifier and targetTitle when it was resolved to one element, #172), for an outdated verification or validation status (`evidence.outdated`) the view whose status is outdated (view) and its reason (message; for an outdated relation with both versions and their dates, D-013). In the order of workspace.check. Only the page of `limit` hints from `offset` (in this order) is listed; `total` counts every hint that passes the filters.

total.description: The number of all hints that pass the filters; `hints` holds the page of `limit` from `offset`.

incomplete.description: True while a repository of the workspace file is not on this machine: the hints of its elements are not listed (SR-006 AK2).
